# Litmatch context pack

> Machine-readable context for the Litmatch social voice app (NestJS core-api, signaling-gateway, LiveKit, Next.js web, Vite admin). Many small files with stable ids; static analysis only; code wins over docs.

## Start here

- [README](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/README.md): id scheme and task routing
- [Module index](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/modules/index.md): 25 modules with counts and links
- [Flows index](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/flows/index.md): 72 cross-service flows
- [Issue ledger](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/issues/index.md): problems met while building
- [Manifest](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/index.json): every entity id with file and related ids

## Human-readable pages (large, not for crawling)

- [System Atlas](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/index.html), [Service Map](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-service-map/), [Error History](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-error-history/)

## Indexes (one per layer)

- [modules/index.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/modules/index.md): modules, one datasheet each
- [slices/index.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/slices/index.md): FEATURE SLICES: follow one feature from screen to database (start here for "follow feature X")
- [fe/index.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/fe/index.md): frontend routes, features, state, errors, i18n, UI action map
- [flows/index.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/flows/index.md): 72 cross-service backend flows
- [api/index.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/api/index.md): REST API contract per module
- [db/index.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/db/index.md): tables per module
- [events/index.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/events/index.md): realtime events, jobs, outbox, metrics
- [errors/index.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/errors/index.md): error codes per group
- [config/index.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/config/index.md): environment variables by prefix
- [service-map/index.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/service-map/index.md): why services talk to each other, techniques, Q&A, findings
- [issues/index.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/issues/index.md): problems met while building (public subset)
- [recipes.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/recipes.md): what past commits of each kind touched
- [reconciliation.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/reconciliation.md): where the atlas and the service map disagree
